author: Samsung
description:
This is the official video introducing the 3-step Auto Clean feature of the Bespoke AI WindFree, Samsung's new room air conditioner.

Sit back and enjoy the comfort of easy maintenance! After use, an Auto Clean function automatically dries  the heat exchanger using a 3-step process. It removes moisture inside by blowing air for 10–30 minutes. So it helps prevent the buildup of bacteria & odors.

So, how does it work?
Step 1: Initially, it blows air for 10 minutes to remove moisture inside the AC.
Step 2: After checking internal humidity and temperature, it proceeds with the Auto Clean process using WindFree™ for 10 minutes.
Step 3: It checks humidity and temperature once more and continues for another 10 minutes of WindFree™ if necessary.

Q. How can I turn on 3-step Auto Clean?
A: To activate Auto Clean, press the “Options” button on the remote for at least 3 seconds, or you can turn it on using SmartThings on your phone.
